messages:
Olivia Chen: Need final social plan for ModelServe v1.2 launch. Goals: webinar signups, demo requests, benchmark downloads. Publish window: Tue 10:00 PT. Deliverables: 6-tweet X thread, 2 LinkedIn posts (company + founder), 3 single-image X posts.

Jamal Reed: Lock UTMs: utm_campaign=msv1_2_launch, utm_source=social, utm_content={slot}. LinkedIn leads -> MKT_LAUNCH_LINKEDIN. X demo asks -> MKT_SOCIAL_INBOUND.

Sara Patel: Design can deliver 3 hero images + story vertical by EOD tomorrow. Need short overlay <=55 chars and long <=140 chars + alt text.

Alex Gomez: Draft X thread (6):
1) ModelServe v1.2 is live ⚡ Faster kernels, smarter routing, lower inference cost. Register: [link]
2) Why it matters: predictable latency + cost for production apps.
3) Highlights: up to 3x throughput (workload dependent); 15–30% token-cost savings.
4) Ops features: canary rollouts, per-route SLOs, automatic fallback.
5) Well share benchmark slides and a test-config repo in the webinar.
6) Register for live Q&A (APAC session available): [webinar link] #ModelServe #RedwoodInference

Maria Liu: Landing form -> SFDC web-to-lead; default owner MKT_QUAL. Short link ready: https://rwd.in/msv1-2 (placeholder). Set utm_content per post. APAC leads -> apac-sdr-group.

Olivia Chen: Quick reply templates for social ops please (short).

Alex Gomez: Replies:
- Demo: "Thanks! Can I DM a link to pick a 15-min slot?"
- Signup: "Thanks for registering! Calendar invite coming. Anything to cover?"
- Benchmarks: "Well send slides if you drop an email."

DesignBot: Figma upload: https://figma.com/file/example/modelserve-assets (mock).

Olivia Chen: Owners: Alex = copy + scheduling, Sara = assets, Maria = tracking, Jamal = landing page & legal, Olivia = approvals. Publish when legal signs off and landing link is final. :rocket:
